description: Installation of two poles and associated security cameras and two collapsible bollards near to the House
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Chiswick House External CCTV Report: Received 04/09/2019. AW1859 & AW4460 Tubular Tilt Down Poles Product Specification: Received 09/04/2019. Unnumbered Retractable Bollards Elevation: Received 02/08/2019. Design and Access Statement, Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Proposed CCTC Column Elevation, Unnumbered Chiswick House & Gardens Buried Services Key Plan, 47066670/ESP/014, 47066670/ESP/006, 47066670/ESP/013, 47066670/ESP/002: Received 23/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The bollards and camera columns shall be removed if they become obsolete.

Condition : 4 - The camera columns shall be painted in Leaf Green - RAL 6002 - so as to appear congruous within the surrounding context of vegetation, unless a similar colour is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
